notes.text: Security update for webkit2gtk3
notes.title: Title of the patch

notes.text:
This update for webkit2gtk3 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-64715: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash (bsc#1277004).
- CVE-2026-64718: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected crash (bsc#1277001).
- CVE-2026-65335: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected crash (bsc#1277015).
- CVE-2026-78376: processing malicious web content can cause a use-after-free issue due to improper memory handling and
  result in memory corruption (bsc#1276418).
- CVE-2026-83596: processing malicious web content can cause memory corruption due to improper memory handling
  (bsc#1277755).
- WebKitGTK and WPE WebKit Security Advisory WSA-2026-0007 (bsc#1290913):
  * CVE-2026-112599: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash.
  * CVE-2026-112615: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process termination.
  * CVE-2026-112623: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to arbitrary code execution.
  * CVE-2026-112626: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to arbitrary code execution.
  * CVE-2026-112637: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to arbitrary code execution.
  * CVE-2026-112639: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to arbitrary code execution.
  * CVE-2026-112640: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to memory corruption..
  * CVE-2026-112651: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to arbitrary code execution.
  * CVE-2026-112653:p rocessing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process termination.
  * CVE-2026-112654: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process termination.
  * CVE-2026-112655: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to arbitrary code execution.
  * CVE-2026-112666: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process termination.
  * CVE-2026-112673: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process termination.
  * CVE-2026-112684: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash.
  * CVE-2026-112686: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process termination.
  * CVE-2026-112693: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected crash.
  * CVE-2026-112695: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process termination.
  * CVE-2026-113897: remote attackers may be able to break out of the Web Content sandbox.
  * CVE-2026-113901: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash.
  * CVE-2026-113903: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to unexpected memory modification.
  * CVE-2026-113904: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash.
  * CVE-2026-86922: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to arbitrary code execution.
  * CVE-2026-86973: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash.
  * CVE-2026-86974: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to memory corruption.
  * CVE-2026-86985: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash.
  * CVE-2026-86986: processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected crash.

Changes for webkit2gtk3:

- Update to version 2.54.3 (bsc#1290913):
  + Add User-Agent quirk for XBox Play.
  + Fix usage of pre-warmed Web content processes.
  + Reduce video format conversions when using the DMA-BUF video sink.
  + Improve handling of text input methods focus handling.
  + Improve handling of surrounding text for input methods.
  + Fix CSS SVG image cursor scaling.
  + Fix north and west face gamepad buttons that were swapped.
  + Improve gamepad input latency.
  + Support usage of GStreamer 1.28.
  + Fix build issues with GCC 16.
  + Fix several crashes and rendering issues.
- Changes in version 2.54.2:
  + Fix performance when compositing layers with backdrop filters.
  + Fix prewarmed web process leak when they are rejected due to sandboxing.
  + Release suspended pages and idle processes on memory pressure.
  + Bind /dev/dxg in the bubblewrap sandbox.
  + Notify input method about cursor area or surrounding text after a re-focus.
  + Clear input method composition underlines before adding new ones.
  + Do not enable input method for read-only text fields.
  + Update the input method state when readonly changes on the focused element.
  + Add User-Agent quirk for OrangeTV.
